initial_gradient_analysis.interpretation: Under gradient descent, the negative owner-logit derivative increases owner mass and the positive conditional-revision derivative decreases revision mass toward draft-hidden. Correct-set-mass reduces both aggregate displacements while leaving every sole-correct presentation fully supervised.
initial_gradient_analysis.method: Exact routing-pattern aggregation at the frozen 0.1/0.8/0.1 initialization, independently checked by centered finite differences over the hierarchical two-logit parameterization.
initial_gradient_analysis.scientific_prediction: If a current screen shows that routing gains are accompanied by excessive unchanged-case loss or drift away from revision, correct-set-mass is the evidence-matched next promotion because it analytically removes equalization pressure from 345 all-correct and 246 two-correct presentations. It is not promoted merely from this analytical result.

measurement_boundary.promotion_condition: At least one currently scheduled 256-row source-disjoint screen must close with complete paired capability, retention, domain, routing, accounting, and custody evidence before this implementation may be scheduled.

rationale: Soft cross-entropy forces equal probability across every correct branch, including 345 all-correct and 246 two-correct presentations. The set-mass objective instead maximizes the total probability assigned to any correct branch: sole-correct rows retain full supervision, two-correct rows penalize only the wrong branch, and all-correct rows contribute zero routing loss. This is intended to conserve the revision-heavy prior and unchanged-case retention without changing the frozen identities, trajectories, controls, seeds, or training budget.
submission_prohibition: Do not submit this architecture or any eighth router before current seven-variant screen evidence authorizes promotion.
